title: Owner-fiber structure and support
statement: Under full-head coherence and orbit-head injectivity, a fixed covered target and requested owner have at most one nonzero contributing source row, determined by the orbit candidate; target sums are bounded by distinct block/orbit-class pairs, and coherence is required only on active coordinates.
verified: A standalone verifier importing nothing from the archive reproduces the finite model; it rebuilds the source row from the integer amplitude and the Lagrange assembly.
Unique contributor: 0 violations over 480 fibers with 48 off-diagonal contributors at Q=2, and 0 over 1,728 fibers with 288 off-diagonal contributors at Q=3.
The candidate lookup predicts the contributing column exactly: 144 of 144 agreements at Q=2 and 480 of 480 at Q=3, with no mismatches.
Class-count bound for sums of target rows: 0 violations over 1,230 sums, with the bound attained 54 times.
Active-coordinate coherence is necessary: breaking it at one active coordinate yields two contributors at target (0,0|1,1).
Degeneracy controls: the known A=0, R>=|D| regime reproduces as diagonal-only, and the run refuses to report success from a degenerate box or from layouts containing no off-diagonal contributor.
unresolved: formal correspondence to the exact packed source definitions
nonclaims: not a native SAT complexity theorem
a finite model check; the packed source definitions are not bound and multiple blocks are not modelled
smallest_decisive_test: Against the exact packed definitions, either prove the unique-contributor statement while preserving missing-address, first-occurrence, repeated-incidence, uncovered-target, and exact-owner branches, or give the smallest counterexample.
